functions.description: Encodes an accessMethod OBJECT IDENTIFIER to DER. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: oid must be a known access method OID.
out/outlen valid for writing.

functions.name: x509_access_method_from_der
functions.signature: int x509_access_method_from_der(int *oid, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses an accessMethod OBJECT IDENTIFIER from DER. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: in/inlen must be DER input; advanced on success.
oid must be non-NULL.

functions.name: x509_access_description_to_der
functions.signature: int x509_access_description_to_der(int oid, const char *uri, size_t urilen, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes AccessDescription ::= SEQUENCE { accessMethod OID, accessLocation GeneralName } using a URI for accessLocation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: oid must be a known access method (e.g., OID_ad_ca_issuers or OID_ad_ocsp).
uri must be non-NULL when urilen > 0; IA5String-valid for uniformResourceIdentifier.
out/outlen valid for writing.

functions.name: x509_access_description_from_der
functions.signature: int x509_access_description_from_der(int *oid, const char **uri, size_t *urilen, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses AccessDescription from DER, extracting the OID and a URI from accessLocation if applicable. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: in/inlen must be DER input; advanced on success.
oid, uri, urilen must be non-NULL; uri points into input buffer and is not NUL-terminated.
Only supports URI accessLocation for this helper; other GeneralName forms may not be decoded here.

functions.name: x509_access_description_print
functions.signature: int x509_access_description_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Prints a DER-encoded AccessDescription. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: fp valid for writing.
d points to DER AccessDescription; dlen length.

functions.name: x509_authority_info_access_to_der
functions.description: Encodes AuthorityInfoAccessSyntax ::= SEQUENCE OF AccessDescription for optional caIssuers and OCSP URIs. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ca_issuers_uri/ocsp_uri may be NULL if their lengths are 0; when length > 0 pointers must be non-NULL and IA5String-valid.
out/outlen valid for writing.

functions.name: x509_authority_info_access_from_der
functions.description: Parses AuthorityInfoAccessSyntax from DER, extracting optional caIssuers and OCSP URIs. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: in/inlen must be DER input; advanced on success.
Output pointers must be non-NULL; returned URIs point into input buffer and are not NUL-terminated.
Only the URI accessLocation forms are extracted by this helper.

functions.name: x509_authority_info_access_print
functions.signature: int x509_authority_info_access_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Prints a DER-encoded AuthorityInfoAccessSyntax to FILE. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: fp valid for writing.
d points to DER AIA; dlen length.

functions.name: cms_content_type_name
functions.signature: const char *cms_content_type_name(int oid);
functions.description: Returns a human-readable name string for a CMS ContentType OID identifier. Useful for logging/printing the CMS content type.
requirements: oid must be a valid CMS ContentType OID value as used by this library
Return is a const pointer; caller must not modify or free the returned string

functions.name: cms_content_type_from_name
functions.signature: int cms_content_type_from_name(const char *name);
functions.description: Parses a CMS ContentType name string and returns the corresponding OID identifier integer.
requirements: name must be a non-NULL, null-terminated string matching a known CMS ContentType name

functions.name: cms_content_type_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_content_type_to_der(int oid, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes the CMS ContentType (OBJECT IDENTIFIER) identified by oid into DER and appends/writes it to the output buffer.
requirements: oid must be a valid CMS ContentType OID value recognized by the library
out and outlen must be non-NULL if encoding output is desired
When encoding into a provided buffer, the buffer referenced by *out must have sufficient remaining space; behavior on insufficient space is library-defined
On success, *out and *outlen are advanced/updated according to the library’s DER writing convention

functions.name: cms_content_type_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_content_type_from_der(int *oid, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded OBJECT IDENTIFIER from the input and returns the CMS ContentType OID value.
requirements: oid, in, and inlen must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded OBJECT IDENTIFIER
*inlen must reflect the available input length and will be decremented/advanced per the library’s DER reading convention

functions.name: cms_content_info_header_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_content_info_header_to_der(int content_type, size_t content_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Serializes only the DER header (SEQUENCE tag/length and explicit [0] wrapper) for a CMS ContentInfo with the given content_type and content length, without including the content bytes.
requirements: content_type must be a valid CMS ContentType OID integer
content_len must be the exact byte length of the to-be-embedded content TLV when the header is paired with actual content
out and outlen must be non-NULL when output is required
Caller is responsible for writing the content bytes after the header as appropriate

functions.name: cms_content_info_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_content_info_to_der(int content_type, const uint8_t *content, size_t content_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes a full CMS ContentInfo SEQUENCE with the specified content_type and an already-encoded content value (full TLV) and writes/appends it in DER.
requirements: content_type must be a valid CMS ContentType OID integer
If content_len > 0, content must be non-NULL and contain a correctly encoded TLV for the content field
out and outlen must be non-NULL for output
The content is expected to be a full TLV per the comment in the header

functions.name: cms_content_info_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_content_info_from_der(int *content_type, const uint8_t **content, size_t *content_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a CMS ContentInfo from DER, returning the content type OID and a pointer/length to the content’s full TLV within the input buffer.
requirements: content_type, content, content_len, in, and inlen must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded ContentInfo structure
On success, *content points inside the input to the full TLV of the content; the caller must not modify or free that memory
*in and *inlen are advanced according to how much was consumed

functions.name: cms_content_info_print
functions.signature: int cms_content_info_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded CMS ContentInfo to the given FILE stream for debugging or inspection.
requirements: fp must be a valid FILE* opened for writing
d must point to a DER-encoded ContentInfo of length dlen
fmt/ind/label control formatting; their valid ranges are library-defined

functions.name: cms_enced_content_info_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_enced_content_info_to_der(int content_type, int enc_algor, const uint8_t *enc_iv, size_t enc_iv_len, const uint8_t *enced_content, size_t enced_content_len, const uint8_t *shared_info1, size_t shared_info1_len, const uint8_t *shared_info2, size_t shared_info2_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes an EncryptedContentInfo structure to DER with the specified content type, content encryption algorithm (and IV/params), the encrypted content OCTET STRING, and optional shared info fields.
requirements: content_type must be a valid CMS ContentType OID integer
enc_algor must be a valid content-encryption AlgorithmIdentifier value understood by the library
If enc_iv_len > 0, enc_iv must be non-NULL and sized appropriately for enc_algor
If enced_content_len > 0, enced_content must be non-NULL and contain the encrypted content bytes
shared_info1 and shared_info2 are optional; if their lengths are > 0, the pointers must be non-NULL
out and outlen must be non-NULL for output

functions.name: cms_enced_content_info_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_enced_content_info_from_der(int *content_type, int *enc_algor, const uint8_t **enc_iv, size_t *enc_iv_len, const uint8_t **enced_content, size_t *enced_content_len, const uint8_t **shared_info1, size_t *shared_info1_len, const uint8_t **shared_info2, size_t *shared_info2_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo, returning content type, algorithm identifier and IV, encrypted content, and optional shared info fields as pointers into the input buffer.
requirements: All output pointer parameters provided must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo
Returned pointers reference memory within the input buffer; caller must not modify or free them and must keep the input buffer valid while using them
*in and *inlen are advanced by the number of bytes consumed

functions.name: cms_enced_content_info_print
functions.signature: int cms_enced_content_info_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo to the given stream.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo of length dlen

functions.name: cms_enced_content_info_encrypt_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_enced_content_info_encrypt_to_der(int enc_algor, const uint8_t *key, size_t keylen, const uint8_t *iv, size_t ivlen, int content_type, const uint8_t *content, size_t content_len, const uint8_t *shared_info1, size_t shared_info1_len, const uint8_t *shared_info2, size_t shared_info2_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encrypts the provided content using the specified content-encryption algorithm and key/IV, assembles an EncryptedContentInfo with the given content_type and optional shared info, and encodes it to DER.
requirements: enc_algor must be a supported content-encryption algorithm identifier
key must be non-NULL with keylen appropriate for enc_algor
If ivlen > 0, iv must be non-NULL and appropriate for enc_algor
If content_len > 0, content must be non-NULL
shared_info1/shared_info2 optional; if lengths > 0, pointers must be non-NULL
out and outlen must be non-NULL for output

functions.name: cms_enced_content_info_decrypt_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_enced_content_info_decrypt_from_der(int *enc_algor, const uint8_t *key, size_t keylen, int *content_type, uint8_t *content, size_t *content_len, const uint8_t **shared_info1, size_t *shared_info1_len, const uint8_t **shared_info2, size_t *shared_info2_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo, decrypts the encrypted content using the provided key, and returns the plaintext content and associated fields.
requirements: enc_algor, content_type, content, and content_len must be non-NULL
key must be non-NULL and keylen must match the algorithm requirements of the parsed enc_algor
content must have at least *content_len bytes available; on input *content_len may be used as capacity depending on library convention
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded EncryptedContentInfo

functions.name: cms_encrypted_data_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_encrypted_data_to_der(int version, int content_type, int enc_algor, const uint8_t *iv, size_t ivlen, const uint8_t *enced_content, size_t enced_content_len, const uint8_t *shared_info1, size_t shared_info1_len, const uint8_t *shared_info2, size_t shared_info2_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes an EncryptedData structure (version and embedded EncryptedContentInfo) to DER.
requirements: version must be INTEGER(1) per the header comment
content_type must be a valid CMS ContentType OID integer
enc_algor must be a supported content-encryption algorithm
If ivlen > 0, iv must be non-NULL
If enced_content_len > 0, enced_content must be non-NULL
shared_info1/shared_info2 optional; if lengths > 0, pointers must be non-NULL
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_encrypted_data_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_encrypted_data_from_der(int *version, int *content_type, int *enc_algor, const uint8_t **iv, size_t *ivlen, const uint8_t **enced_content, size_t *enced_content_len, const uint8_t **shared_info1, size_t *shared_info1_len, const uint8_t **shared_info2, size_t *shared_info2_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded EncryptedData structure and returns its fields as pointers into the input buffer where applicable.
requirements: All output parameters provided must be non-NULL
*in must point to a valid DER-encoded EncryptedData
Returned pointers reference memory within the input buffer; caller must keep the buffer valid and must not free/modify those pointers

functions.name: cms_encrypted_data_print
functions.signature: int cms_encrypted_data_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded EncryptedData object.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded EncryptedData of length dlen

functions.name: cms_encrypted_data_encrypt_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_encrypted_data_encrypt_to_der(int enc_algor, const uint8_t *key, size_t keylen, const uint8_t *iv, size_t ivlen, int content_type, const uint8_t *content, size_t content_len, const uint8_t *shared_info1, size_t shared_info1_len, const uint8_t *shared_info2, size_t shared_info2_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encrypts content with the given algorithm and key/IV, wraps it in EncryptedData (version 1) with the specified content_type and optional shared info, and encodes to DER.
requirements: enc_algor must be supported
key must be non-NULL with keylen suitable for enc_algor
If ivlen > 0, iv must be non-NULL and suitable for enc_algor
If content_len > 0, content must be non-NULL
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_encrypted_data_decrypt_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_encrypted_data_decrypt_from_der(int *enc_algor, const uint8_t *key, size_t keylen, int *content_type, uint8_t *content, size_t *content_len, const uint8_t **shared_info1, size_t *shared_info1_len, const uint8_t **shared_info2, size_t *shared_info2_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded EncryptedData, decrypts its encrypted content using the provided key, and returns the plaintext content and content type.
requirements: enc_algor, content_type, content, and content_len must be non-NULL
key must be non-NULL with keylen appropriate for the parsed algorithm
content must provide sufficient capacity for the output plaintext per library convention
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded EncryptedData

functions.name: cms_issuer_and_serial_number_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_issuer_and_serial_number_to_der(const uint8_t *issuer, size_t issuer_len, const uint8_t *serial_number, size_t serial_number_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes an IssuerAndSerialNumber structure (X.509 issuer Name and serialNumber) to DER.
requirements: If issuer_len > 0, issuer must be non-NULL and contain DER-encoded Name
If serial_number_len > 0, serial_number must be non-NULL and contain DER-encoded INTEGER
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_issuer_and_serial_number_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_issuer_and_serial_number_from_der(const uint8_t **issuer, size_t *issuer_len, const uint8_t **serial_number, size_t *serial_number_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses an IssuerAndSerialNumber from DER, returning pointers to the embedded DER-encoded issuer Name and serialNumber INTEGER within the input buffer.
requirements: issuer, issuer_len, serial_number, serial_number_len, in, and inlen must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded IssuerAndSerialNumber
Returned pointers reference memory within the input buffer

functions.name: cms_issuer_and_serial_number_print
functions.signature: int cms_issuer_and_serial_number_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded IssuerAndSerialNumber.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded IssuerAndSerialNumber of length dlen

functions.name: cms_signer_info_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_signer_info_to_der(int version, const uint8_t *issuer, size_t issuer_len, const uint8_t *serial_number, size_t serial_number_len, int digest_algor, const uint8_t *authed_attrs, size_t authed_attrs_len, int signature_algor, const uint8_t *enced_digest, size_t enced_digest_len, const uint8_t *unauthed_attrs, size_t unauthed_attrs_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes a SignerInfo structure to DER with issuer/serial, digest algorithm, optional authenticated/unauthenticated attributes, signature algorithm, and encrypted digest (signature).
requirements: version must be INTEGER(1) per header comment
issuer/serial_number must be DER-encoded Name and INTEGER if lengths > 0
digest_algor and signature_algor must be valid AlgorithmIdentifier values recognized by the library
If authed_attrs_len > 0, authed_attrs must be a DER-encoded IMPLICIT SET OF Attribute
If enced_digest_len > 0, enced_digest must be non-NULL and contain the signature bytes
If unauthed_attrs_len > 0, unauthed_attrs must be DER-encoded IMPLICIT SET OF Attribute
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_signer_info_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_signer_info_from_der(int *version, const uint8_t **issuer, size_t *issuer_len, const uint8_t **serial_number, size_t *serial_number_len, int *digest_algor, const uint8_t **authed_attrs, size_t *authed_attrs_len, int *signature_algor, const uint8_t **enced_digest, size_t *enced_digest_len, const uint8_t **unauthed_attrs, size_t *unauthed_attrs_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SignerInfo and returns its component fields as values and/or pointers into the input buffer.
requirements: All provided output parameters must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded SignerInfo
Returned pointers reference memory within the input buffer and must not be freed or modified by the caller

functions.name: cms_signer_info_print
functions.signature: int cms_signer_info_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded SignerInfo.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded SignerInfo of length dlen

functions.name: cms_signer_info_sign_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_signer_info_sign_to_der(const SM3_CTX *sm3_ctx, const SM2_KEY *sm2_key, const uint8_t *issuer, size_t issuer_len, const uint8_t *serial_number, size_t serial_number_len, const uint8_t *authed_attrs, size_t authed_attrs_len, const uint8_t *unauthed_attrs, size_t unauthed_attrs_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Computes a CMS SignerInfo using SM3/SM2 over the provided content digest context and signs with the given SM2 private key, assembling and encoding the SignerInfo to DER.
requirements: sm3_ctx must be a valid SM3_CTX representing the message digest state appropriate for CMS signing per library convention
sm2_key must be a valid, initialized SM2 private key
issuer and serial_number must identify the signer certificate (DER-encoded) if lengths > 0
If authed_attrs_len > 0, authed_attrs must be a valid DER-encoded attribute set as required by CMS
unauthed_attrs optional; if length > 0, must be valid DER
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_signer_info_verify_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_signer_info_verify_from_der(const SM3_CTX *sm3_ctx, const uint8_t *certs, size_t certslen, const uint8_t **cert, size_t *certlen, const uint8_t **issuer, size_t *issuer_len, const uint8_t **serial, size_t *serial_len, const uint8_t **authed_attrs, size_t *authed_attrs_len, const uint8_t **unauthed_attrs, size_t *unauthed_attrs_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SignerInfo, locates the signer’s certificate within the provided certs set, and verifies the signature using the digest context. Returns pointers to selected fields and the matched signer cert.
requirements: sm3_ctx must be a valid SM3 digest context matching the message to be verified per library convention
certs must point to a DER-encoded SET OF Certificate of length certslen when provided
Output pointer parameters must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded SignerInfo
Returned pointers reference memory within either the input or provided certs buffer; caller must keep them valid and not free them

functions.name: cms_signer_infos_add_signer_info
functions.signature: int cms_signer_infos_add_signer_info(uint8_t *d, size_t *dlen, size_t maxlen, const SM3_CTX *sm3_ctx, const SM2_KEY *sign_key, const uint8_t *issuer, size_t issuer_len, const uint8_t *serial_number, size_t serial_number_len, const uint8_t *authed_attrs, size_t authed_attrs_len, const uint8_t *unauthed_attrs, size_t unauthed_attrs_len);
functions.description: Appends a newly generated SignerInfo (computed with SM3/SM2) into an existing DER-encoded SET OF SignerInfo buffer, updating its length.
requirements: d must point to a buffer with capacity maxlen; dlen must be initialized to the current length of the SET
sm3_ctx must be a valid digest context; sign_key must be a valid SM2 private key
issuer/serial_number must identify the signer certificate if lengths > 0 and be DER-encoded
authed_attrs/unauthed_attrs must be valid DER sets if lengths > 0

functions.name: cms_signer_infos_print
functions.signature: int cms_signer_infos_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded SET OF SignerInfo.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded SET OF SignerInfo of length dlen

functions.name: cms_digest_algors_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_digest_algors_to_der(const int *digest_algors, size_t digest_algors_cnt, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes a SET OF AlgorithmIdentifier for digest algorithms to DER from an array of algorithm identifiers.
requirements: digest_algors must point to at least digest_algors_cnt entries if count > 0
Each algorithm identifier integer must be valid/recognized by the library
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_digest_algors_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_digest_algors_from_der(int *digest_algors, size_t *digest_algors_cnt, size_t max_digest_algors, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SET OF digest AlgorithmIdentifier values into an integer array.
requirements: digest_algors must point to a buffer capable of holding up to max_digest_algors entries
digest_algors_cnt must be non-NULL to receive the number of parsed entries
in and inlen must be non-NULL and point to a DER-encoded SET
max_digest_algors must be large enough for the input; otherwise parsing may fail

functions.name: cms_digest_algors_print
functions.signature: int cms_digest_algors_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded SET OF digest AlgorithmIdentifier.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded SET of AlgorithmIdentifier of length dlen

functions.name: cms_signed_data_to_der
functions.signature: int cms_signed_data_to_der(int version, const int *digest_algors, size_t digest_algors_cnt, const int content_type, const uint8_t *content, const size_t content_len, const uint8_t *certs, size_t certs_len, const uint8_t *crls, const size_t crls_len, const uint8_t *signer_infos, size_t signer_infos_len, uint8_t **out, size_t *outlen);
functions.description: Encodes a SignedData structure (version, digestAlgorithms, contentInfo, optional certificates/CRLs, and signerInfos) to DER.
requirements: version must be INTEGER(1) per header comment
digest_algors must reference digest_algors_cnt valid identifiers
content_type must be a valid CMS ContentType; content must be the encoded content (for data, raw bytes per note in sign helper)
certs/crls optional: if lengths > 0, must be DER-encoded SETs per CMS
signer_infos must be a DER-encoded SET OF SignerInfo if length > 0
out and outlen must be non-NULL

functions.name: cms_signed_data_from_der
functions.signature: int cms_signed_data_from_der(int *version, int *digest_algors, size_t *digest_algors_cnt, size_t max_digest_algors, int *content_type, const uint8_t **content, size_t *content_len, const uint8_t **certs, size_t *certs_len, const uint8_t **crls, size_t *crls_len, const uint8_t **signer_infos, size_t *signer_infos_len, const uint8_t **in, size_t *inlen);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SignedData and returns its components, including content type and a pointer to the encoded content, and optional certificates/CRLs/signerInfos.
requirements: All output parameters provided must be non-NULL
*in must point to a well-formed DER-encoded SignedData
max_digest_algors must be sufficient to hold all parsed algorithms
Returned pointers reference memory within the input buffer

functions.name: cms_signed_data_print
functions.signature: int cms_signed_data_print(FILE *fp, int fmt, int ind, const char *label, const uint8_t *d, size_t dlen);
functions.description: Pretty-prints a DER-encoded SignedData.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*
d must point to a DER-encoded SignedData of length dlen

functions.name: cms_signed_data_sign_to_der

The executing CPU must support the RDSEED instruction; otherwise the function may fail (inferred from the function name).
Behavior when buflen == 0 is not documented in this header and is therefore unknown.

functions.name: sha1_init
functions.signature: void sha1_init(SHA1_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Initializes a SHA-1 hashing context for a new message digest computation. Call this before any sha1_update calls and prior to sha1_finish. Typical usage: allocate a SHA1_CTX, call sha1_init, then one or more sha1_update calls with input data, and finally sha1_finish to produce the 20-byte digest.
requirements: ctx must be a non-NULL pointer to writable memory of at least sizeof(SHA1_CTX).
Must be called before sha1_update and sha1_finish for a given context.
If reusing a context for a new computation after sha1_finish, call sha1_init again first.
The function performs no I/O and is not thread-safe with concurrent access to the same context.

functions.name: sha1_update
functions.signature: void sha1_update(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t *data, size_t datalen);
functions.description: Feeds a chunk of message data into an initialized SHA-1 context. Can be called multiple times to process data incrementally. Combine with sha1_init prior to the first call and sha1_finish after the final call to obtain the digest.
requirements: ctx must be non-NULL and must have been initialized with sha1_init.
data must point to at least datalen bytes of readable memory when datalen > 0.
It is safe to call this function with datalen == 0; in that case data may be ignored.
May be called multiple times to process a stream of data; order of calls defines the message sequence.
Do not call after sha1_finish on the same context unless sha1_init is called again.
Not safe for concurrent calls on the same context from multiple threads.

functions.name: sha1_finish

functions.description: Finalizes the SHA-1 computation and writes the 20-byte digest to dgst. After finishing, the context represents a completed hash; reinitialize with sha1_init to compute another digest.
requirements: ctx must be non-NULL and must have been initialized with sha1_init (and optionally updated with sha1_update).
dgst must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable buffer of at least SHA1_DIGEST_SIZE (20) bytes.
After calling sha1_finish, do not call sha1_update on the same context unless it is reinitialized via sha1_init.
Caller is responsible for securely handling the digest and any sensitive context data if needed.
Not safe for concurrent calls on the same context from multiple threads.

import os
import random
from typing import List

# Data type: arbitrary binary
# Target stubs consume FUZZ_PARAM_STR() as arbitrary byte strings for:
# - sm3_update data chunks
# - sm3_hmac_init keys (0..64 bytes)
# - sm3_hmac_update data
# - sm3_kdf_update input
# - sm3_digest_init optional key (0..64 bytes)
# - sm3_digest_update data
# - sm3_compress_blocks base block (will be resized to 64 bytes by stub)
#
# Strategy:
# Generate a compact container that concatenates several tagged byte segments
# so that FUZZ_PARAM_STR() can be satisfied with varied but valid content
# across calls. We keep total size <= 4096.
#
# Layout of the buffer we generate:
# [count(1)] repeated segments: [tag(1)] [len(1)] [len bytes payload]
# Tags guide diversity but the fuzzer stubs don't parse tags; they just pull
# strings sequentially. Still, mixing sizes and contents increases coverage.
#
# We include segments of sizes suitable for keys (0..64), small/medium message
# chunks, and exact 64-byte blocks useful for sm3_compress_blocks.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

# Helper to create random bytes of a given length with a mix of printable and binary
def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    if n <= 0:
        return b""
    # Compose from patterns to exercise different paths
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    remaining = n
    while remaining > 0:
        choice = rng.randrange(5)
        chunk = min(remaining, rng.randrange(1, min(33, remaining + 1)))
        if choice == 0:
            # ASCII letters
            parts.append(bytes(rng.choice(b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ") for _ in range(chunk)))
        elif choice == 1:
            # Hex-like
            parts.append(bytes(rng.choice(b"0123456789abcdef") for _ in range(chunk)))
        elif choice == 2:
            # Zero bytes
            parts.append(b"\x00" * chunk)
        elif choice == 3:
            # Increasing pattern
            start = rng.randrange(256)
            parts.append(bytes(((start + i) & 0xFF) for i in range(chunk)))
        else:
            # Fully random
            parts.append(os.urandom(chunk))
        remaining -= chunk
    return b"".join(parts)[:n]

def _make_segment(rng: random.Random, tag: int, length: int) -> bytes:
    payload = _rand_bytes(rng, length)
    # Segment encoding: tag(1), len(1), payload
    return bytes([tag & 0xFF, length & 0xFF]) + payload

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Decide number of segments (aim 8-24)
    count = rng.randrange(8, 25)
    segments: List[bytes] = []

    # Always include some special-sized segments helpful for stubs
    # 1) A 64-byte block (useful for sm3_compress_blocks base)
    segments.append(_make_segment(rng, tag=0xA0, length=64))
    # 2) Empty segment to exercise zero-length data paths
    segments.append(_make_segment(rng, tag=0xA1, length=0))
    # 3) Typical HMAC key sizes (16, 32, 64)
    for t, L in [(0xA2, 16), (0xA3, 32), (0xA4, 64)]:
        segments.append(_make_segment(rng, tag=t, length=L))

    # Remaining segments: random mix of small/medium sizes with occasional 64
    while len(segments) < count:
        tag = rng.randrange(0x20, 0x7F)
        # Bias lengths: many small (0..32), some medium (33..128), few 64 exactly
        pick = rng.random()
        if pick < 0.5:
            length = rng.randrange(0, 33)
        elif pick < 0.85:
            length = rng.randrange(33, 129)
        else:
            length = 64
        segments.append(_make_segment(rng, tag=tag, length=length))

    # Prepend count
    buf = bytes([len(segments) & 0xFF]) + b"".join(segments)

    # Ensure max size
    if len(buf) > MAX_TOTAL:
        buf = buf[:MAX_TOTAL]

    return buf
